Description: Yubeh is the daughter of Shapur II and Sithil-Horak and the sibling of Shapur III and Zruanduxt. Life in the royal household makes her aware that a visit or gift may be interpreted as support for someone. She dislikes accepting vague demands merely to keep an appearance of harmony and prefers to clarify responsibilities in private. She is concerned for her mother and reminds her siblings that not everyone claiming to speak for their father deserves trust. She wants her judgement respected without being treated as someone authorised to promise anything on the whole family’s behalf.
